PointDetectionTest.pins: 3D point source detection (demos/demo_point_detection_3d_*.m) on synthetic Gaussian spots with known positions, amplitude and background. The detection mex functions are not built for ARM macOS, so these tests are skipped there (see MexInventoryTest).

estimateSigmaFromBead.pins: GU_estimateSigma3D (demo step 2) on a single bead

lowSNRDetectionRuns.pins: 'lowSNR' (used in the detection demos) used to call crop_image_by_bounding_box, which doesn't exist, and to drop all detections without a camera noise threshold. It filters detections by their residual std, which assumes camera noise.

runDetectionWritesDetectionsAndMask.pins: getShortPath (used for messages) used to fail on Windows for paths with '/' separators, which these tests use

trackingLinksSpotsAcrossFrames.pins: detection + tracking (demo step 5.1) on a 3-frame movie with spots moving by a fraction of a voxel per frame
